subject: Q3 hiring cap realignment — proposed redistribution & offer cadence
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 hiring cap realignment — proposed redistribution & offer cadence

Team,

I ran the updated headcount model overnight and we need to make a short-term decision to keep OPEX in line with revenue pacing for Q3. Proposal below (high level):

- Freeze net new external reqs for non-core growth marketing and discretionary bench roles effective immediately (reassess in 8 weeks).
- Reallocate two approved backend/platform ICs from Sales enablement to Platform backlog (saves ~2.0 FTE-equivalent cost by improving throughput).
- Pause issuing new offers above band midpoint for roles outside of Platform/ML until we validate ARR motion.

Attached: headcount_q3_model_v2.xlsx (model, scenario A/B).

Can I get buy-in from Finance + Talent to implement these controls and a short comms plan for candidates in-flight? If we can't pause offers, we need to identify offsetting headcount reductions.

I suggest a quick sync tomorrow for owners only (15 min).

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: headcount_q3_model_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 hiring cap realignment — proposed redistribution & offer cadence

Vivek — thanks for running this. I support prioritizing Platform hires; backlog is causing lost conversion on trials. A couple quick items:

- Sales has two reps in offer-stage with negotiated comp that would be hard to roll back; recommend we honor those and count them toward hiring cap.
- I can free up one SDR req by shifting a marketing associate role to a contractor until we revisit.

Happy to join the owners-only sync.

—Aditya

Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 hiring cap realignment — proposed redistribution & offer cadence

Vivek,

Quick update from Talent side after scanning offers/pipelines:

- Offers already extended (should be honored unless execs approve rescind): 3 full-time (2 sales, 1 product).
- Active interview loops where offers expected within 2 weeks: ~7 candidates (mixed orgs).
- Recommendations:
  * Pause issuing any new offers for non-platform roles this week.
  * Where candidates are mid-process, convert to "pause" communications and maintain warm outreach (do not ghost).
  * For the three offers already extended, we recommend proceeding to signatures.

I attached the current offer_tracker_q2.csv export. We can redact compensation lines in the public comms.

If Finance wants an alternative, please list the specific reqs to deprioritize and we will put offers on hold accordingly.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Dir, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 hiring cap realignment — proposed redistribution & offer cadence

Team — reviewed the model and scenario A (conservative). Finance will approve a temporary reallocation with conditions:

- Approve reallocation of 2 reqs to Platform as proposed, effective immediately.
- Pause extension of offers above midpoint for non-core roles for 8 weeks; exceptions require CFO sign-off.
- Offer commitments already executed (signed offers) are approved to proceed.
- Talent to provide weekly tally of candidate status and expected start dates (shared sheet).

We will reconvene at the end of 8 weeks for a Q3 checkpoint; if revenue pacing improves we can lift the restrictions.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — summary & next steps: 

1) Approved: reallocation of 2 backend/platform reqs to Platform (Aditya will reassign the req owners).
2) Approved: temporary hold on offers above band midpoint for non-core roles for 8 weeks; signed offers proceed.
3) Talent (Marissa): publish paused-candidate template by EOD and update offer_tracker_q2.csv with a "pause_status" column (weekly).
4) Recruiter (Sofia): pause new submittals for Sales Ops / Product until we confirm exceptions; send templated messaging to your candidates.
5) Finance (Markus): provide one-sentence exception criteria and the approval path for any urgency cases.

I'll run the owners-only 15-min sync at 11am PT today to align comms and owners. Please bring any sensitive candidate cases to that meeting.

Vivek
